name: Polyplex Corporation Limited
summary: Polyplex Corporation Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of polymeric films in India, other Asian countries, Europe, the Americas, and internationally. It offers Sarafil base films, including biaxially-oriented polyester (BOPET) films for use in packaging, electrical, and industrial applications; BO polypropylene (PP) films for flexible packaging and other applications; cast and blown PP films for flexible packaging and other applications; sustainable films; holographic films; and transfer metalized papers.
